_about: Energy and macronutrient rules for crew meal planning. All numbers are quoted from the cited NASA/NASEM documents; nothing here is estimated.

default_daily_energy.rule: [V2 7003] provide an average of 12,698 kJ (3,035 kcal) per crewmember per day, else compute EER with Table 7.1-1 and an activity factor appropriate to mission gravity and planned physical activity
default_daily_energy.reference_population_note: With AF=1.25: average of 84 male crew (82.9 kg) = 3,041 kcal; 20 female crew (65.1 kg) = 2,344 kcal

activity_factor.range_note: JSC 67378 (cited in Rev E rationale) notes activity factors from 1.0 to 1.25 based on local gravity and exercise capability

eer_equations.caveat: HIDH Rev 1 Table 7.2-1 prints the male intercept as 622; NASA-STD-3001 Rev E and OCHMO-TB-013 print 662 (matching the NASEM DRI equation). Use 662.

eva_energy.rule: [V2 7004] additional 837 kJ (200 kcal) per EVA hour above nominal intake, similar in nutrient content to the rest of the diet
eva_energy.suited_nutrition_rule: [V2 11025] provide a means for in-suit nutrition for surface EVAs > 4 h or any suited activity > 12 h

protein.text: 0.8 g/kg and <= 35% of total daily energy intake and 2/3 animal, 1/3 vegetable protein

macronutrients_nasa_hidh.fiber_note: 4187 kJ = 1000 kcal, i.e. 10-14 g fiber per 1000 kcal
macronutrients_nasa_hidh.status: Guideline table from 2005 (JSC 63555) reproduced in HIDH Rev 1; current NASA-STD-3001 Rev E defers to DRIs except vitamin D

spaceflight_micronutrient_exception.rule: [V2 7100] DRIs apply except as noted in Table 7.1-2 (vitamin D 25 ug/day). OCHMO-TB-013: DRIs may be tailored to individual crewmember needs.

historical_iss_intake_reference.note: Observed mean intakes (not requirements) from OCHMO-TB-013 backup table, ISS expeditions E26-34
historical_iss_intake_reference.carb_fat_pct_note: ISS columns in source table give energy, protein, Ca, Fe, Na, K only
